messages:
alex_h: Heads-up: onboarding customer "Helios" hitting errors when scaling GPU pools in us-west-2. Suspect interface endpoint / target group limits.

maria_ops: Can you paste the error logs?

alex_h: ```
ERROR: Failed to register targets for target group arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:...: Target.AttachmentLimit.Exceeded
ERROR: AttachNetworkInterface failed: Insufficient free addresses in subnet '10.0.32.0/20'
``` 

raj_sre: Sounds like two things: (1) VPC Interface Endpoint quota + ENI/IP exhaustion, (2) per-NLB target association limit. We've hit both before when autoscaling GPU fleets.

lee_infra: Opened AWS case 1234567891 requesting increases: "Interface endpoints per VPC" 50 -> 500, "Network interfaces" quota bumped in region, "Target group associations per NLB" 1000 -> 5000. AWS said ~72h to review.

maria_ops: Do we need to expand the VPC CIDR instead of just quota? If subnets are /24s we might run out of IPv4 addresses quickly for ENIs.

alex_h: Short-term mitigation: reduce per-instance registration by using fewer listener ports and moving some services behind internal LB proxies. Also consider consolidating private endpoints per service (we currently create one per cluster/az).

deploy-bot: Deploy failed: service gpu-launcher v23.4 - attach eni error -> rolling back.

raj_sre: Cost/ops note: Interface endpoints have per-hour and per-GB charges. If we increase count, add tagging + cost center tracking. Also add a runbook: if target registration fails, scale-in suspects and switch to fallback smaller batch size.

lee_infra: Action items: (1) maria_ops to run inventory of current interface endpoints + free IP counts by AZ, (2) raj_sre to draft runbook + limit guards in autoscaler, (3) I'll monitor AWS case and post updates.

maria_ops: Ack — running inventory now, will post CSV to #eng-infra in ~30m. @lee_infra please add the Helios onboarding deadline (EOD Fri) to the case comments so AWS understands urgency.

alex_h: Thanks team. If AWS can't meet quota timelines we may need to stagger onboarding or provision in another region (us-east-1) where quotas are healthier.

lee_infra: Noted. tagging @cloud-ops for cross-account quota increases if needed.
